identity: ONE original bulky armoured mechanical beast, the Rivet Hound veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter side view. Keep the heavy overlapping curved brass armour plates with rivets, the long curved armoured snout that opens into two jaws, the small red eye, the two short exhaust stacks on the back, the curled segmented brass tail, and EXACTLY FOUR jointed blue steel legs with heavy clawed brass feet. No rider and no extra legs. Preserve the four legs, the armoured snout, the stacks and the bulky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the snout tip, the tail and all four feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, smoke, steam, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra legs. The beast moves only at its joints and jaws; the armour plates stay rigid and never morph.

idle_h3_v1.action: A heavy, watchful idle that loops. The beast breathes, the armoured body rises and settles, the snout lifts slightly and the jaws part a little and close, the tail sways, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. All four feet stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Trot in place on four legs through two complete cycles with heavy mechanical steps. Diagonal pairs of legs alternate lifting, swinging forward and planting their clawed feet while the others bear the weight. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel with the snout held level and the tail swaying. Exactly four legs at all times. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE snapping lunge toward screen right. The beast lowers its head and opens the armoured jaws wide, then drives forward off its hind legs and stretches the snout to full reach at screen right where the jaws snap shut, then draws back and settles into the original stance. One bite only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The beast flinches down low, the legs compress and the head ducks, then it rises back up on all four feet and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Hunker down: the beast drops its belly low with the armoured back plates raised, tucks the snout down and braces all four legs wide, then holds the low armoured crouch. No attack and no return to the standing stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A challenge. The beast rears up on its hind legs with the front legs lifted and the snout raised high, jaws open wide as if roaring, holds the pose briefly, then drops back onto all four feet in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no sound waves, glow or effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Shut down and collapse. The legs buckle and the heavy body sinks down onto its belly, stays a moment, then slumps over and settles flat on the ground with the legs folded and the snout resting at screen right, finishing as a still wreck. The same body throughout: no explosion, no smoke and no disappearing.
